messages:
sasha: Quick check — where are the finalized weights for mpt-30b-instruct that we want to run quantization on? I started a small eval pass and noticed a tokenizer quirk: tokenizer_v2 seems to insert an extra space after BOS which shifts ROUGE by ~0.8% on XSUM. Also getting a config validation error on seq_len vs kv_cache. Need: weights path, canonical tokenizer config, and sign-off for calibration dataset size (how many samples for AWQ/GPTQ).

maria: weights are at s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/instruct/final/v3/mpt-30b-instruct-v3.bin (md5: 3f6d2a7c). We also pushed a small tokenizer patch to fix the BOS behavior — see commit 9c4b8. For config validation: set `max_seq_len: 2048` and `enable_kv_cache: true` in model config to match serving runtime.

maria: quick command to run calibration locally if useful:
```
python tools/quant/calibrate.py \ 
  --model-path s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/instruct/final/v3/mpt-30b-instruct-v3.bin \ 
  --tokenizer configs/tokenizer_v2.json \ 
  --calib-set s3://redwood-datasets/calib/summaries/10k.jsonl \ 
  --bits 4 --method awq \ 
  --out-dir /tmp/mpt30b-awq-calib
```
Use --calib-set 5k/10k/20k for sensitivity sweeps.

kevin: For Dedicated/Hosted routing we need the model-catalog updated with the quant profiles. Minimal snippet to add to model-catalog.yml:
```yaml
models:
  - name: mpt-30b-instruct
    version: v3
    weights: s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/instruct/final/v3/mpt-30b-instruct-v3.bin
    quant_profiles: [awq-4bit, gptq-4bit, fp8-experimental]
    max_seq_len: 2048
```
I'll open the PR after we confirm the calibration plan.

maria: Accuracy tradeoffs we've observed: AWQ 4-bit keeps generation quality pretty close on summarization / classification, but sometimes loses on very long contexts — off by ~1 token on greedy metrics. GPTQ 4-bit is slightly more stable but longer compile & slower kernels. FP8 gives best perf/latency but requires runtime kernel changes (we need ops fused on our runtime). Recommendation: run AWQ calibration at 10k samples, evaluate on 3 seeds + a long-context eval set. If delta <1% on primary metrics, approve AWQ->staging canary.

sasha: That sounds reasonable. Leah — can you sign off on AWQ 4-bit staging canary if calibration + eval pass? Also, do we need a perf/SLO gating threshold?

leah: Suggest SLO gate: latency increase <8% at p95, and quality drop <1.5% absolute on lead eval (XSUM/LLM-qa). If both met, approve AWQ->staging canary. Hold FP8 until runtime kernel tests finish.

deploy-bot: automated-checks: calibration-size-check ✅ (10k sample set found), config-schema-validation ✅, weights-checksum-match ✅

kevin: I'll bump model-catalog and add the quant_profiles entry, open PR now and tag @maria for CR. Also will add a canary route in staging for awq-4bit.

maria: On it — will CR the catalog PR and kick off a full 10k AWQ calibration job tomorrow morning. Will post results + eval report in this thread.

sasha: Awesome, thanks — will wait for the eval report then we can flip the staging canary. :thumbsup:
